name: Local SEO Lesson
body:
> Course · 2026-10-08

# Summary
The Local SEO Masterclass from Local Rank Academy (Skool), saved as 21 PDFs on 2026-10-08. It has two parts:
- A short, blunt **rank-and-rent track** (6 lessons) by the Indexsy / LocalRank.so team. Several tactics in it break Google policies.
- A structured **Local SEO course for beginners** (Modules 1 to 16; Module 14 is not in the saved set) that is mostly white-hat and reads like an agency SOP.

# Big ideas worth keeping
- Proximity, relevance and prominence drive the map pack; GBP category and completeness come first.
- One master NAP document, copied everywhere, with duplicates merged and old data suppressed.
- Reviews: ask everyone, never gate or incentivize, respond to all.
- Local links from real community ties beat bulk links.
- Track baselines, conversions and GBP insights, and report as a story.

# TAG caution
Do not use: purchased or fake GBP locations, invented suites, paid direction or click traffic, friend or incentivized reviews, review gating, PBN tiering. These can get a client listing suspended.
